questions.questionText: You ask "What's your return policy?" and no 🔧 line appears. Why?
questions.explanation:
The model chooses when to call tools. A question with no matching tool gets a plain answer.

(A) A crash would show an error. Here the model simply chose to answer.

(C) Gradio sends every message to `chat()`. The model is the one that decides about tools.

options.optionText: The model decided no tool fits this question, so it answered directly
Gradio only sends price questions to the agent

questions.questionText: The homework hint says the agent can gain memory. What does that take?
questions.explanation:
Re-sending past turns is the memory trick from the LangChain section.

(A) Model size does not add memory. The hint is about passing the chat history in.

(C) `share=True` only creates the public link. It does not affect memory.

options.optionText: Passing `history` into the agent so it can see past turns
